record.bible_text: Woe<WH01945> to the rebellious<WH05637><WTH8802> children<WH01121>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, that take<WH06213><WTH8800> counsel<WH06098>, but not of me; and that cover<WH05258><WTH8800> with a covering<WH04541>, but not of my spirit<WH07307>, that they may add<WH05595><WTH8800> sin<WH02403> to sin<WH02403>:

The burden<WH04853> of the beasts<WH0929> of the south<WH05045>: into the land<WH0776> of trouble<WH06869> and anguish<WH06695>, from whence <FI>come<Fi> the young<WH03833> and old lion<WH03918>, the viper<WH0660> and fiery<WH08314><WH00> flying<WH05774><WTH8789> serpent<WH08314>, they will carry<WH05375><WTH8799> their riches<WH02428> upon the shoulders<WH03802> of young asses<WH05895>, and their treasures<WH0214> upon the bunches<WH01707> of camels<WH01581>, to a people<WH05971> <FI>that<Fi> shall not profit<WH03276><WTH8686> <FI>them<Fi> .

That this <FI>is<Fi> a rebellious<WH04805> people<WH05971>, lying<WH03586> children<WH01121>, children<WH01121> <FI>that<Fi> will<WH014><WTH8804> not hear<WH08085><WTH8800> the law<WH08451> of the LORD<WH03068>:
